motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shared CSS media query shortens animation and transition durations and disables smooth scrolling.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared compact action; the large variant is 36px high.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));color:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 85%,transparent);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Shared compact action; the large variant is 36px high.
components.css: .ds-button-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));}.ds-button-outline:hover{background:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));color:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));}.ds-button-outline:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-outline:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-outline:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-outline{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Email field
components.description: A labeled shared field with visible keyboard focus and invalid state.
components.css: .ds-label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-input{width:240px;max-width:100%;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.85 0 0));border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:4px 12px;font-size:16px;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms;}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--destructive, oklch(0.55 0.21 27));}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-input{font-size:14px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Numbered navigation rail
components.description: Report contents with active page emphasis; the mobile strip hides indices.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 8px;gap:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));}.ds-nav a>span{display:none;}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));font-weight:700;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px currentColor;}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));outline-offset:-2px;}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-nav{flex-direction:column;gap:0;}.ds-nav a{min-height:0;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.85 0 0));}.ds-nav a>span{display:block;width:20px;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{box-shadow:none;}}

components.name: Published badge
components.description: A compact shared status badge with an explicit label and inline SVG.
components.html: Published
components.css: .ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;padding:2px 6px;background:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));color:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-badge:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 90%,transparent);}

components.name: Report card
components.description: Shared Card with an ink top rule and compact inner spacing.
components.html:
Search Console

Search performance for this site.
components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));border-radius:0;background:var(--card,oklch(0.985 0 0));color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));padding:16px;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;}.ds-card h2{margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.375;letter-spacing:-.025em;}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));}

components.name: Numbered section rule
components.description: SectionHead aligns an index, title and optional aside over a fine rule.

components.name: Key figure
components.description: Neutral large tabular value with a quiet label, drawn from StatGrid.
components.css: .ds-stat{padding:16px 0;border-top:4px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.85 0 0));color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-stat p{margin:0;font-size:30px;line-height:1;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-stat span{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));}

narrative.overview: The working annual report: a compact numbered navigation rail, strong page rules, large key figures and dense operational tables. Schibsted Grotesk and neutral paper keep the existing admin coherent; status color helps an operator interpret state.
keyCharacteristics: Large tabular figures beside compact operational detail.
Square shared controls and semantic status color.

rules.name: State Color
rules.body: Use chromatic color to communicate state; keep the surrounding report neutral.

dos: Do reuse @repo/ui controls, palette and Schibsted Grotesk.
Do keep report sections, statistics and tables aligned with the existing admin grid.
Do accompany status color with a readable label or icon.
Do keep graph filters in normal document flow above the canvas.
donts: Don’t introduce decorative brand colors or a separate visual identity for new dashboard pages.
Don’t turn every report section into a raised card.
Don’t imply per-user roles in an instance with shared full-admin access.
